model: Versioned derived market snapshots are reproducible projections over canonical V13 source records. Snapshot identity binds market subject, source-set hash, aggregation version and window so reorg replacements remain distinct without overwriting prior derivations.
fields: best bid / best ask when available
invariants: snapshot identity is derived from market subject, source-set hash, aggregation version and window
same derivation with conflicting payload fails closed
older windows cannot replace the latest market snapshot
same-window reorg replacement with a distinct source-set hash receives a distinct snapshot ID
prior reorg derivations remain addressable rather than silently overwritten
best bid cannot exceed best ask when order-book data is available
OHLCV high/low bounds must contain open and close
trade-derived fields and volume are zero when no trade data is available
bid/ask values are zero when order-book data is unavailable
snapshot projection grants no execution, custody, mint, burn or settlement authority
